name: clauseway/playbook
title: Playbook (rules checked against clauses)
description: Your rules on the left, the contract clauses on the right. Each rule draws a line to the clause it matched and marks it as matching or off playbook.

rules.default:
Liability capped at 12 months of fees | 2 | off
Indemnity runs both ways | 4 | ok
Notice to end early: 30 days or more | 3 | ok
Payment due in 45 days or more | 1 | off

clauses.default:
Payment | Customer will pay each invoice within fifteen days of receipt.
Liability | Provider's liability will not exceed the fees paid in the prior three months.
Termination | Either party may end this Agreement on thirty days' written notice.
Indemnity | Each party will defend and hold the other harmless against third-party claims.
